summary.text: Kim Ross is a Democratic member of the Maryland House of Delegates from District 8 who was appointed in March 2025 and is on the ballot in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A communications professional, she sits on the House Health Committee.

paragraphs.text: Ross earned a bachelor's degree in English from North Carolina Central University and a master's degree in strategic communications from the University of Maryland Global Campus, and she holds a graduate certificate from New York University.

Her career has been in communications and editing: she was financial news manager at Media Mill Works from 2003 to 2006, a public relations account executive at Stanton Communications from 2005 to 2007, editor and communications manager at the National Association of Public Health Systems from 2007 to 2010, and senior communications manager at the Association of Public Health from 2010 to 2014.
Since 2014 she has worked as an editorial leader in content services.
Ross has served in the House since March 3, 2025, when Gov. Wes Moore appointed her to replace former Delegate Carl Jackson.
She serves on the Health Committee and on its Health Facilities, Insurance, and Maternal, Infant, and Child Health subcommittees, and she belongs to the Legislative Black Caucus of Maryland.
She is a member of the Board of Trustees of the Community College of Baltimore County.
She finished first in the June 23, 2026 Democratic primary for District 8.
